{{Quote|We've lost contact with Project Quell, in the lower ground labs. It's, um, supposed to study those rakghoul creatures. They kept a whole pack of them there. The scientists wanted to study the rakghouls' behavior, try to find weaknesses we could use.|Selro|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Project Quell''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] research project on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that studied the behavior of [[rakghoul]]s. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zalaren]] was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] on the project, and was the only survivor when the rakghouls broke loose in the [[Project Quell Research Lab|research lab]] and attacked the scientists.
